title: マイルCSの後に・ヘイルメリー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle emerges victorious from the heated clash with a G1 race win under her belt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race now over, Silence Suzuka makes a revelation—Taiki's fiery running touched her to the core and showed her what she was missing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both aiming for higher speed, Suzuka announces her plans to run in Hong Kong, while Taiki sets the Yasuda Kinen as her next target.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Mile Championship behind us, all that's left is to wait for the Umamusume of the Year announcement. Will Taiki Shuttle achieve her dreams? Only time will tell.
